title: chanks-5-session-doc repository policy (.session-doc.json)
description: Committed at the repository root. Resolves the optional Notion projection and the OpenSpec directory for documentary closure.

enabled.description: Explicitly disables the Notion projection for this repository.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page id of the project's status page, in either shape Notion hands out: 32 hex chars, or the dashed UUID the web UI shows. Required unless Notion is explicitly disabled.

notion_url.description: Optional human-readable URL of the Notion page.

openspec_dir.description: Relative path to the OpenSpec directory for technical session docs.
